settings.heading: Our Journey
settings.subheading: neOwn began in 2023 with a simple goal: to make reading accessible and enjoyable for all kids.
settings.bottom_desc:
neOwn began with a simple goal: to make reading accessible and enjoyable for all kids. Inspired by our founder’s journey as a mother of two — neOwn was designed to solve common challenges parents face.

From cluttered shelves and endless purchasing to the need for consistent reading habits, Kranti created neOwn as a digital library solution for parents who want a better way to support their children’s growth through reading.

Today, neOwn is more than just a library; it’s a complete support system to help parents raise confident, well-rounded kids.

We believed access matters more than ownership. So we built neOwn to give families:
  • Affordable learning without constant buying
  • Clutter-free childhoods
  • Age-appropriate books & toys every month
  • A way to build strong reading habits

Today, thousands of families trust neOwn to support joyful, everyday learning.

settings.header: Do you deliver all over India?
settings.content:
Currently, we only deliver books all over India. 

Delivery is free within Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Mira-Bhayander. 

Outside Mumbai: There is an additional delivery charge for Book Library deliveries outside Mumbai. 

(Toy Library is only operating in Mumbai as of now)

settings.header: How does the Library Subscription work?
settings.content:
Step 1: 📚🧸You can subscribe to any plan from our website. 

Step 2: 📲Download the neOwn app to select your books or toys. 

Step 3: 📦Books/toys will be delivered and the pickup and exchange will happen after maximum 30 days

Step 4: 🔁Finally you return and repeat the same for all the following months of your subscription!

settings.header: How can I select my books/toys?
settings.content:
Once you have subscribed, you can download our app📲 from which you can select the books or toys 📚🧸

You can select any books/toys of your choice, and in case you are not sure what to pick we have a book expert in-house who can help you out if needed 💖

settings.header: How to download the neOwn app?
Is there any deposit or registration fee?

settings.header: How do you sanitize the books & toys?
settings.content:
Our process to ensure the books & toys are hygenic and in good condition: 

  • All toys are cleaned by our team before and after they go to or come back from any customer to ensure they are 100% sanitary
  • ⁠⁠We also clean board books to ensure they are 100% sanitary 
  • ⁠We do a thorough check of all books & toys twice - once after they have come back from customers and the second time before they are going to another customer 
  • ⁠⁠If any books or toys are of bad quality we don't circulate it among customers anymore
